shadowMode.reason: Prevent duplicate notifications before a chain is cut over.

cutoverTransaction: Verify three consecutive Scout shadow runs with matching evidence
Set Scout automation teamsNotify to the chain cutover value
Run one explicit Scout Teams Bot notification probe
Read back the Teams Bot message/session evidence
Disable the matching OpenClaw Cron delivery and job
Read back both schedulers and prove Scout is the only enabled owner
Monitor the next scheduled Scout run and its Teams delivery
rollbackTransaction: Re-enable the exact legacy OpenClaw Cron only if the operator explicitly approves rollback
Verify one notification owner before leaving rollback

s360-daily.content: Daily report outcome and exact evidence; zero-vulnerability days included

s360-orchestrator.content: Only actionable changes, blockers, or failures

s360-phase3.content: Only tag-plan approval candidates, mismatches, blockers, or failures

pbi-cost-daily.content: Actual, run-rate, budget variance, model verification, and evidence digest

meeting-scheduler.content: Meeting briefs or action items only when grounded in calendar/transcript evidence

weekly-build-monitor.content: Failures, in-progress exceptions, retry proposals, or weekly all-green digest

forbiddenAfterCutover: duplicate Teams sends from both framework and m_send_teams_message
